'''Aedelle Baryn''' is an [[Andoran]] noblewoman. She is sister to [[Lir Baryn]].
==Activities==
[[Arymilla]] tells [[Elenia]], [[Naean]], and [[Sylvase Caeren|Sylvase]] that Aedelle's cook has made an excellent meal for them and that they must join her.
